name: microsoft_graph-mcp
description: Outlook / Microsoft 365 (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply, mark_read. Every too

platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_client_secr.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_client_secr.description: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_refresh_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_GRAPH_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_microsoft_graph_refresh_tok.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Mail.ReadWrite Mail.Send. Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Inbox, newest first. Graph pages through @odata.nextLink and says 'Don't try to extract the $skip value', so `page` is ignored; `since` is not sent. text is bodyPreview ('The first 255 characters of the message body'); thread_id is conversationId.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: All messages of a conversation (`thread_id` = conversationId from list_inbound) via an OData $filter; `page` is ignored.

tools.name: send
tools.description: sendMail in JSON (plain-text body, one recipient `to`); answers 202 with no body, so no message id: 'A 202 Accepted response code indicates that the request has been accepted; however, it doesn't indicate that the request processing has completed'.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: `thread_id` is the MESSAGE id to reply to (a message `id`, not conversationId); the reply goes to its sender with `text` as the comment. 202, no body.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: PATCH isRead=true on one message (`message_id` required).
